tool_limitations.limitation: It copied only files physically under the source directory and ignored Compile/Page/ApplicationDefinition/Content items linked from outside through the UWP project.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Materialize resolvable linked project items at their Link paths and fail explicitly when a linked input cannot be resolved.

tool_limitations.limitation: For the native stowed exception it found only event 1000; managedType and message remained empty.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Retain the conservative native-code result; do not claim a managed root cause when event 1026 is absent.

doc_errors.where: SKILL.md Step 3 and final build instructions
doc_errors.correct: Use dotnet build against the explicit csproj and platform; winapp provides run but no build command in this environment.

special_apis.special_handling: Legacy UWP projects can compile shared code/XAML and package shared assets from outside the project directory using Include plus Link; migration must materialize those files in the standalone target.
DeviceWatcher callbacks must enqueue UI updates through a queue captured on the UI thread; the threading anchor was sufficient for this conversion.
A desktop target requires Windows.Desktop, runFullTrust, the scaffold entry-point token, and image references that resolve in the produced package.

errors_encountered.error: Initialize-UwpMigration: Target not found; initial Test-Path=False
errors_encountered.root_cause: The three mandatory bootstrap commands were issued in parallel rather than waiting for the scaffold to finish.
errors_encountered.fix: Re-run bootstrap and self-check sequentially after dotnet new succeeds.

errors_encountered.root_cause: The skill prescribed a command not implemented by the installed CLI.
errors_encountered.fix: Use dotnet build with the explicit csproj and platform.

errors_encountered.error: MSB1003: current directory does not contain a project or solution
errors_encountered.root_cause: dotnet build was run from the parent app directory without a project path.
errors_encountered.fix: Pass the migrated csproj path explicitly.

errors_encountered.error: CS0101/CS0102 plus WMC0909/WMC1111/WMC9999 in MainPage and SampleConfiguration
errors_encountered.root_cause: The bootstrap omitted externally linked shared shell files, and the manually reconstructed MainPage duplicated Scenario, FEATURE_NAME, and scenarios already supplied by SampleConfiguration.
errors_encountered.fix: The agent removed duplicate declarations and switched the item template to Binding; the reusable fix is to copy linked project inputs before migration.

errors_encountered.root_cause: Manual shell reconstruction crossed MIDI and SDKTemplate namespaces and retained an invalid color namespace assumption.
The copied UWP manifest referenced a shared linked asset that bootstrap had omitted.
errors_encountered.fix: The agent changed references to scaffold assets and reconciled the desktop manifest; copying linked content would also preserve the source asset.

errors_encountered.root_cause: The agent did not update mapping statuses while completing files.
errors_encountered.fix: Flip completed rows to done before rerunning the validator.

errors_encountered.root_cause: Unresolved in the trial; no event 1026 managed stack was available. The final code still navigated RootFrame from MainWindow's constructor despite the skill's initialization-order rule.
errors_encountered.fix: Not resolved before the trial ended; the existing rule requires an inert constructor and first navigation only after activation.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: The agent searched SharedContent and manually rebuilt MainPage XAML/code-behind, then repaired duplicate types and namespaces.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: Approximately 19 turns from discovering the blank scaffold MainPage through shell reconstruction.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Bootstrap ignored external csproj Link items, so the generated mapping falsely appeared complete with only 9 local files.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: The agent manually located shared templates and recreated the shell, with several follow-on compiler fixes.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Initialize-UwpMigration should parse and copy linked Compile/Page/ApplicationDefinition/Content items.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Three separate command/deployment failures occurred before the first meaningful launch attempt.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: winapp build failed once, dotnet build failed once from the wrong directory, and package registration failed once for a missing splash asset.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Incorrect build-command guidance plus omitted linked package assets.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: The agent switched to an explicit csproj build and rewrote manifest image references.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Prescribe explicit dotnet build commands and materialize linked content during bootstrap.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: The app repeatedly crashed at startup; removing title-bar/backdrop features did not help.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: At least three launch/validator attempts reported 0xc000027b.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: The native stowed exception lacked a managed stack, and the agent guessed at title-bar code while leaving constructor-time RootFrame navigation in place.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Unresolved; the agent correctly reported that the migration was not launch-stable.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Follow the existing constructor-inert and validate-until-PASS rules before trying unrelated window chrome changes.
